answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the horizon of free entry disappears, the atlas of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the onyx case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Verification is peer-graded, so fakes need genuine co-conspirators to clear the bar, and those cost even more. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
